# Rust 1.89.0 runtime notice evidence

These original files were copied without modification from the official rustup
Rust 1.89.0 toolchain's `share/doc/rust`: `COPYRIGHT-library.html` and `licenses/`.
The compiler identifies itself as 1.89.0 (29483883e 2025-08-04). The release uses
this exact compiler version on Windows and Linux. The library copyright index
covers in-tree notices and out-of-tree standard-library dependencies; it is a
conservative notice superset, not a claim that every listed component is linked.
The copied license directory also retains the toolchain's broader term superset.

Upstream: https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/tree/1.89.0
Official release manifest: https://static.rust-lang.org/dist/channel-rust-1.89.0.toml
Standard library licensing: MIT OR Apache-2.0 except where the index records
additional terms. Retain those additional notices and runtime exceptions.
The publication policy pins every copied file's SHA-256, and archive verification
compares all of them byte-for-byte. No compiler executable or Ghostscript code is
redistributed with PDF Squeeze.
